body:
Someone names the unfashionable preference and wins more respect than the tasteful silence ever did.

They give the real answer to what they want, at the dinner, in the negotiation, on the second date, and the sky does not fall.

With Venus sextile Lilith, the people managing the pleasant exchange can briefly afford the preference that pleasantness kept off the menu.

The honest version is cheap for a moment, but somebody still has to order it.

The evening may pass politely either way, but the people who name a desire while it costs little set the standard for what the relationship can hold.
